notes.title: Patch Notes 7/18 - Improvements
notes.notes:
[list][*] Improved animal responsiveness to movement, their animations will look much more fluid now.
[*] Improved the "Parkour" scoring system. This bumped the "Jumper" achievement from 185 to 215 points.
[*] Clarified the position of Ronnie's box, and switched its reference to "Crate." Thank you Steam user cowell547 for pointing this out!
[/list]

Patch is 2.0 MB

notes.title: Patch Notes 7/17 - Some Fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare reload bug which would put 0 bullets into a magazine after reloading twice in a row.
[*] Improved ragdoll physics, they won't fly as often now.
[*] Improved loot balance on Level 3, it's much harder to run out of ammo now.
[*] Improved loot balance on the "Northern Run" minigame. Medkits will be more common while ammo will be less.
[*] The Bandits on Level 6 now react to things that are farther away, the level will be more difficult now.
[/list]

Patch is 1.6 MB
